data.title: NCC 1982 — Pointy ideas with a solid point.
data.headline: Pointy ideas with a solid point.
data.subheadline: Introducing the Logix Mouse. Point, select, and get to work.
data.status: Accepted alternative-history offering and planned campaign; budgets are planning provisions, not observed spending.
messages: Point directly to your work: keyboard and mouse work together.
See more in your information: colour Abacus reports and professional drawings.
Choose a platform that grows with you: upgrades, independent software and compatible manufacturers.
data.availability: June colour/mouse offering and around-June professional hardware availability. AutoCAD is a November COMDEX development target, not a June shipping application.
data.software_update_policy: CP/M and AIONix TUI mouse updates carry no new licence fee for existing licensed users; fulfillment media ships with mouse/upgrade kits (costed in mouse pack). Standalone replacement media and installation are quoted separately. Replaceable TUI services can update existing binaries; static libraries require relinking, custom drawing requires adaptation.
presentation: Open a familiar Abacus worksheet and edit with keyboard.
Use the mouse to select a field, activate a button and scroll with both rollers.
Show a colour report with labels/patterns preserving monochrome meaning.
Demonstrate a supported older application and explain its exact update path.
Show the colour upgrade for an existing compatible Artemis.
Close with qualified 800x600 professional graphics and the Autodesk November target.

booth_zones.name: Try it yourself
booth_zones.demo: Two-minute mouse tutorial, then Solitaire/FreeCell and the same actions in a business application.

booth_zones.name: Your business at work
booth_zones.demo: Abacus and supported business applications with realistic data.

booth_zones.name: Professional graphics
booth_zones.demo: Dual displays and engineering line/curve tests; distinguish Logix diagnostics from an actual AutoCAD preview.

booth_zones.name: One platform, several suppliers
booth_zones.demo: Named partner systems and explicitly tested application configurations.

packages.name: Artemis Colour Upgrade
packages.notes: For a compatible existing Artemis; replaces its primary video card. TUI update licence included. Installation/training separately quoted, no automatic trade-in credit.

packages.name: Artemis Professional Graphics extension
packages.notes: Requires a qualified host and existing primary display/card. AutoCAD not included. If a mouse is already owned, quote components without a second mouse.

packages.name: Logix Mouse Learning Pack
packages.notes: One mouse, its driver/update media and one Entertainment Suite copy; existing computer/display required.

data.office_configuration: Dealer-quoted Artemis Office Graphics configuration with Abacus and the Colour Upgrade. Replace included primary card/monitor in the base system BOM and quote once; do not sell a base bundle plus another full display/card without crediting removed parts. No invented fixed-price complete-system SKU.
data.developer_program: Demonstrate task -> branch -> discussion -> target build -> test -> labelled release. Promote $745.23 Team Edition with clear one-server/four-concurrent-user entitlement; hardware separate. Offer scheduled porting clinics and documented compatibility testing.
data.autodesk_claim: Autodesk is developing AutoCAD for Artemis with a complete Logix-funded development environment; joint November COMDEX presentation is the target. Show an early Autodesk build only if approved and stable, labelled development software.
claim_controls: Four simultaneous grays selected from 16 levels on the 128 KiB card.
No universal mouse retrofit or blanket CP/M binary-compatibility claim.
Professional monitor timing, grayscale and blitter performance require measured qualification.
Do not imply NCC prices guarantee supplier quotes or completed manufacturing qualification.
metrics: Qualified demonstrations and scheduled follow-up appointments
Confirmed upgrade orders by SKU; separate from free demonstrations
Independent developer projects started and target tests completed
Partner participation with actual supported configurations
Professional evaluation requests and later AutoCAD invitations
data.followup: Assign an owner to every qualified enquiry; telephone or postal follow-up within five business days. Measure 30/60/90-day conversion without assuming automatic sales uplift.
